mission_07: Excellent! You have built a hybrid quantum-classical model that seamlessly integrates classical neural network layers with quantum circuits. The classical pre-processing layer transforms raw inputs into quantum-ready features, the quantum layer leverages superposition and entanglement for complex feature transformation, and the classical post-processing layer extracts measurable features and produces final predictions. This hybrid architecture is the most practical approach for current quantum hardware: the quantum circuit can be kept small enough to run on NISQ devices while the classical layers handle the heavy computation. The quantum layer acts as a powerful, trainable feature extractor that operates in an exponentially large Hilbert space, potentially capturing patterns that classical layers alone would miss.
